quality.review_scope: All six supplied main pages read and visually reviewed; independently audited source extraction and sample links. SI not located or verified. Shared template variants are not independent growth runs. No experimental atomic-structure or exact-size label is asserted.
missing_fields: Matching SI not located or verified.
Initial wafer cleaning reagents/conditions, oxidation temperature/time/atmosphere and wafer doping/resistivity are unreported.
PMMA molecular weight, solvent, solution concentration, coating method and spinning conditions are not reported; no spin-coating step is invented.
Developer ratio basis, bath temperature and development duration are unstated.
CF4/CHF3 flow ratio, etch pressure/power/time and endpoint parameters are unreported; no endpoint detection was used.
10% HF concentration basis, solvent, exact dip duration, rinse/dry and transfer conditions are unreported.
Gas stock fraction and sccm reference basis are unstated; gas purity/supplier, temperature ramp, cool-down and final storage are unreported.
Both well sizes occur on the same substrate/exposure; individual wafer or specimen identifiers are not supplied.
No measured atomic coordinates, XRD/SAED figure, Raman spectrum or near-IR spectrum is supplied.
AFM tip dimensions/force/scan settings, TEM thinning procedure, Raman settings and near-IR setup unreported.
conflicts: Figure 1 caption gives approximately 60–150 nm photoresist openings, whereas process prose gives approximately 60 and 100 nm; final etched openings are 100 and 150 nm.
Figure 2 body identifies 100 nm wells and a 25 square-micrometre field, whereas its caption identifies 150 nm wells. Keep the image unassigned to either template variant.
Title page prints Received July 6, 1995 and In Final Form November 6, 1994. This internally inconsistent chronology is preserved.
